      # OPTIONS methods (they are not applied to real responses), and the
      # preflight stays unauthorized - api_gateway.cors.note "预检不挂授权器",

        AllowHeaders: "'Authorization,Content-Type,Access-Control-Request-Headers'"
        AllowOrigin: "'*'"

      # The format is the one this pipeline's own AWS E2E harness deploys and
      # parses: responseLatency minus integrationLatency is the time API Gateway

      # measurement needs to split "gateway" from "Lambda".
